intent: New scenery sources; no source integration before owner acceptance
requestReferenceMechanism: Inspected author references described in the prompt; no image tool input paths for brand-new generation

request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone environmental raster illustration layer for Remilo P02 artwork-only review. Create NEW scenery, not a UI screenshot.
Style: soft 2D editorial/cartoon illustration with broad rounded asymmetric silhouettes, clean smooth edges, restrained gentle tonal gradients within shapes and two to four overlapping layers. Flat illustrated space; match the calm layered vocabulary of Remilo's accepted Sunrise rolling hills and Meadow edge canopy. Very sparse fine detail. No dimensional bevels, sculpted clay, glossy highlights, plastic, photorealism, dramatic spot lighting, grain or noisy texture.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background/alpha; no checkerboard pixels. A separate solid atmospheric canvas and real UI will be rendered later. No text, lettering, logos, phones, app chrome, buttons, cards, controls, frames, watermarks, faces, characters, weather symbols, glitter, floating orbs or isolated centered display objects. Crop-safe environmental forms extend beyond the source edges. This is standalone artwork only. No quiet-zone boxes drawn into the source.
Visual references inspected by the author: supplied time-of-day-and-alarms and Butter/Periwinkle/Sage boards; accepted S1 Sunrise horizon and M1 Meadow canopy. Those files are quality/style references, not edit targets. Broad environmental coverage and calm negative space are the relevant relationships.
Primary request: Sky candidate SK1. Landscape composition approximately 3:2. A broad airy blue cloud-and-hill horizon spanning the full width. Three sweeping rounded hill layers in powder blue, pale periwinkle-blue and restrained muted slate-blue. Simple substantial soft cloud groups float just above the layered horizon, all consistent with the hills, without a sun or other central object. Compose lower terrain with asymmetric rhythm, continuing beyond left/right/bottom edges.
Composition: bottom-center anchor. The upper approximately 40% stays transparent and quiet; the cloud/hill environment occupies the lower half to two-thirds, with a soft alpha transition above terrain. Important silhouettes remain recognizable if the decorative region is shortened. Do not bake an opaque full sky into the source. Atmospheric, gently luminous and blue rather than violet. No sharp mountain peaks or tiny busy foliage.
